title: Assess the (provider, category) bucket stale flag on the latest version, not every ancestor
objective: apps/api/app/read_api/service.py:693 sets the bucket-wide has_stale_evidence flag with `any(v.id in stale_versions for v in offer.versions)` -- EVERY version of every published offer, superseded ancestors included. Because coverage.derive_coverage_state returns 'stale' before it can return 'verified_free', one stale ancestor version anywhere in a bucket costs EVERY offer in that bucket its verified_free badge on the public catalogue. The offer's actual claim rests on queries.latest_version(offer); PR #95 settled that basis and F008 S7 applied it to the counts on this very row. The flag never got that treatment.

latest_version_call_sites_in_service_py.method: AST walk over ast.Call nodes, NOT a string count -- a string match can be a docstring, a comment, or a quotation of the thing being retracted
latest_version_call_sites_in_service_py.disagreement: MINE DIFFERS: 8 elsewhere, not 9. The 9th call is line 677, INSIDE the loop being repaired. This strengthens the case rather than weakening it: the function already computes `latest` (677) and `latest_id` (678), appends latest_id to bucket_versions (679), and then line 693 ignores it.

measurements_i_made_rather_than_inherite.second_inconsistency_not_named_in_the_br: Within serialize_category_matrix itself, the cell's DISPLAYED evidence_currency (line 726) is computed from bucket_versions, which holds LATEST ids only (line 679), while has_stale_evidence (line 693) is computed from ALL versions. The same cell of the same JSON response can therefore report evidence_currency = current and derived_state = 'stale' simultaneously. This is one row contradicting itself, which is a sharper demonstration than disagreement with 8 other call sites.
measurements_i_made_rather_than_inherite.why_ancestors_are_in_the_set: queries.fetch_stale_offer_version_ids calls fetch_evidence_currency(session, now=now) with NO offer_version_ids scope, so the returned frozenset spans every offer version in the database, superseded ancestors included. Both halves of the mechanism are confirmed, not assumed.
measurements_i_made_rather_than_inherite.public_badge_confirmed: apps/web/src/catalogue/CategoryMatrix.tsx:174 renders derived_state into the cell title text and :185 emits it as a data-derived-state attribute. This is user-facing state, hence Level 2.

predictions_frozen_before_any_measuremen.protocol: Recorded in writing BEFORE the measurement harness was run, including the arms I am confident about. A confident prediction that fails is the most informative result available. The baseline suite (2995 passed / 3 skipped / 2998 collected) was taken before this file was written; no measurement of the DEFECT had been run at the time these were recorded.

P1.claim: A real publish of the committed corpus yields ZERO offers with >= 2 versions.
P1.mechanism: publisher.py:377 returns early with version_created=False when prior.content_hash == content_hash, and a single pass over fixed committed fixtures cannot change the hash. version_number only increments at publisher.py:389.

P2.claim: Therefore the clock sweep finds ZERO bucket derived_state differences between the two rules at EVERY clock, and the defect is LATENT rather than live.

P3.claim: Publishing the committed corpus TWICE with unchanged fixtures still yields exactly 1 version per offer, exercising the content-hash short-circuit directly rather than by inference.

P4.claim: A second pass with CHANGED content does create version_number = 2 and does reproduce the defect, establishing that the code path is reachable in production even though the corpus does not exercise it.

P5.claim: At least one corpus bucket currently derives verified_free, so the blast radius is non-zero. Falsifiable: the committed fixtures may all be past their refresh window at real now, in which case every bucket is already stale for an unrelated reason and the blast-radius claim goes UNMEASURED and must be reported as such.

P6.claim: The defect-restoring mutation will be killed ONLY by the new PERMIT test, not by any pre-existing test, because no existing fixture in the repository is multi-version. If a pre-existing guard kills it, that is investigated before the kill is accepted -- accepting a kill by a pre-existing guard is how a holed guard ships called verified.

measure_first_gate.question: Does ANY real provider's derived_state differ TODAY between the current all-versions rule and a latest-version rule?
measure_first_gate.why_it_gates: Nobody has measured this. If no real bucket is affected the slice is a latent-correctness fix plus a guard and must SAY SO PROMINENTLY. If real buckets ARE affected it is a live defect on a public badge and must be reported to the owner BEFORE any implementation.
measure_first_gate.M1_version_census: Real ingest+publish of all 7 configs under config/examples/providers against their committed tests/fixtures/ingest fixtures, via build_fixture_fetcher + run_provider_scans(publish=True). VACUITY GUARD FIRST: assert published offers > 0, because 'no difference found' over an empty catalogue proves nothing and will be reported as nothing rather than as reassurance. Then the distribution of versions-per-offer, stating the population.
measure_first_gate.M2_clock_sweep_diff: For each clock in a sweep (every distinct fetched_at + window boundary +/- 1s, plus far-past and far-future), compute for every (provider, category) bucket the derived_state under the current all-versions rule and under the proposed latest-only rule, and report every difference WITH DIRECTION (stale -> verified_free is wrongly WITHHELD; verified_free -> stale is wrongly ASSERTED). Both columns are TRANSCRIBED from the ORM graph rather than imported -- comparing a function to itself would look rigorous and prove nothing -- and the current-rule column is then cross-checked against the shipped serialize_category_matrix output. A mismatch there invalidates the harness, not the code. Population reported as buckets x clocks.
measure_first_gate.M3_reachability: Two real publish passes where the second pass's content differs, producing version_number = 2. EXPLICITLY LABELLED CONSTRUCTED and quarantined in its own section: it establishes that the code path is reachable as providers change terms, and it CANNOT answer 'does this happen today'. Synthetic data is admissible for testing the guard and inadmissible as evidence about the world.

fork_decided_in_advance.no_real_bucket_affected: Lead the report with LATENT, not live. Slice becomes a consistency fix plus a guard.
fork_decided_in_advance.real_buckets_affected: STOP. Report providers, categories and direction to the owner before implementing anything.

design_decision_one_rule_or_two.decision: ONE rule. The bucket flag is assessed on queries.latest_version(offer), the same basis as every other currency assessment in the codebase.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.argument_1_the_code_contradicts_its_own_: CoverageSignals.has_stale_evidence is documented as 'At least one SOURCE BACKING THIS PAIR is past its refresh window'. A superseded version does not back the pair; the pair's claim rests on current versions. The fix makes the code mean what it already says.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.argument_2_self_contradiction_not_merely: See second_inconsistency_not_named_in_the_brief above. One cell, two answers about which versions back the claim.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.argument_3_the_conservatism_defence_fail: fetch_stale_offer_version_ids documents itself as deliberately conservative because 'overstating staleness only ever makes the catalogue admit uncertainty, which is the direction the product errs in'. I agree with the brief that this is weaker than it looks, and for a reason worth stating precisely: conservatism concerns uncertainty about THE CURRENT CLAIM. A superseded version carries no uncertainty about the current claim -- it is evidence about a claim that has been REPLACED. Importing it is a category error wearing caution's clothes. It is also not conservative in EFFECT: because stale outranks verified_free in derive_coverage_state, this 'caution' WITHHOLDS a true free claim from every offer in the bucket, and coverage.py has already ruled on that direction in MATERIAL_MISMATCH_DISPLAY -- 'Suppressing a true free claim is a defect too.' A wrongly-withheld free offer is a defect of equal severity to a wrongly-asserted one, and it is the direction a reader cannot see, because an omission leaves no trace on the page.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.argument_4_precedent: PR #95 settled that an offer's claim is assessed on latest_version(offer), with rollups taking currency.for_versions([latest ids]).worst(). F008 S7 (PR #99) applied that basis to free_offer_count / current_free_offer_count on this same row. This is the flag half of a fix already half-landed.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.scope_discipline_the_axis_NOT_changed: There are TWO distinct coarsenesses here and the S7 docstring blurs them. (a) ACROSS OFFERS in a bucket: one offer whose LATEST version is stale marks the whole cell. That is what bucket-wide properly means; it is legitimate, deliberate and DELIBERATELY UNTOUCHED by this slice. (b) ACROSS VERSIONS within one offer: a superseded ancestor marks the offer. That is the defect. Only (b) changes.
design_decision_one_rule_or_two.docstring_obligation: service.py lines 651-654 currently assert that the coarser rule 'is unchanged by this slice; its behaviour is deliberately not touched'. That sentence becomes FALSE the moment this lands, so rewriting it is part of the change, not an optional tidy. It will be rewritten to draw the (a)/(b) distinction rather than to delete the paragraph.

acceptance_criteria: AC1 MEASURE FIRST reports before any production edit: whether any real provider bucket differs today, which, and in which direction, with the population stated beside every count.
AC2 The vacuity guard fires or passes explicitly: a 'no difference' result over zero published offers is reported as proving nothing.

AC3 PERMIT ARM: a bucket whose offers' latest versions are all current, but which contains a stale superseded ancestor version, derives 'verified_free'. This test FAILS at base commit ab3dfc00 and passes after the fix.
AC4 WITHHOLD ARM: a bucket whose LATEST version is genuinely stale still derives 'stale'. Passes both before and after, and is proven load-bearing by its own mutation rather than asserted to be.
AC5 Mutation M-orig restores the ORIGINAL DEFECT as valid code with correct arity (not an arity break) and is KILLED, with the killing test id NAMED.
AC6 Mutation M-over ('or False') is KILLED by the WITHHOLD arm, demonstrating the fix cannot over-correct into wrongly asserting freshness.
AC7 Every mutation run asserts its search text is PRESENT before substitution and ABORTS if absent, reports collected N > 0, and treats pytest exit 5 as nothing-collected.
AC8 If any mutation is killed by a PRE-EXISTING guard, that is investigated and reported rather than accepted as confirmation.
AC9 Full suite after the change shows a delta equal to exactly the tests added, against the recorded baseline.
AC10 The across-offers axis is shown to be unchanged: a bucket with a second offer whose latest version is stale still derives 'stale'.
AC11 agent-state/progress.md is appended to and proven append-only by raw byte-prefix comparison PLUS a flipped-byte negative control demonstrating the check can fail.
AC12 The database container and its volume are removed with EXACT-NAME filters and their absence verified, with the exact names reported.

verification_method.database: Own PostgreSQL, container fta-bucketstale-pg, volume fta-bucketstale-vol, host port 55440 probed free before use (5432 is freetier-atlas-postgres-1, 55432 is ftci-pg). Seeded separately from the suite's DB.
environment_preconditions_asserted_not_a: A2 pg_isready exit code 0, polled, CHECKED
A3 a real SELECT 1 through SQLAlchemy over the EXACT DATABASE_URL the tests use
A4 alembic upgrade head exit code 0
A5 required tables present in information_schema
verification_method.why: A CREATE DATABASE with an unchecked exit code once printed 'ready', every integration test then failed on the missing DB, and the harness read that as a KILL. A false KILL confirms whatever you hoped.
verification_method.baseline_shown_to_have_executed: 2995 passed, 3 skipped, 2998 collected, exit 0, recorded BEFORE any edit. Not merely exit 0: 2995 tests demonstrably executed, and only 3 skipped, so the integration layer really ran against this database.

migration_and_data_implications: None. No schema change, no migration, no write. app.read_api holds a reads-and-never-writes invariant and this slice does not breach it. The derivation remains computed on demand and unstored, per decision Q11 -- a stored projection would become a second source of truth that silently goes stale, which is the failure the stale state exists to expose.

security_privacy_portability_z0.security: No boundary, secret, auth or input-handling change. No user-controlled URL. No network access added.
security_privacy_portability_z0.portability: No new dependency, no provider-specific logic, no mandatory managed-cloud service. PostgreSQL remains the only mandatory stateful service.
security_privacy_portability_z0.z0: DIRECTLY MATERIAL and the reason this is Level 2. The change can only ever move a bucket FROM 'stale' TO a state the evidence supports, and only when the latest version's evidence is current. It cannot cause an offer whose CURRENT evidence is expired to be presented as free -- that path is unchanged and is guarded by AC4. The zero-cost-safety risk of this slice is over-correction, which is why the WITHHOLD arm carries its own mutation rather than merely existing.

regression_risks: Over-correction into never-stale, wrongly ASSERTING freshness -- guarded by AC4 + AC6.
Silently changing the across-offers bucket-wide semantics -- guarded by AC10.
Leaving the S7 docstring asserting something that is no longer true -- addressed as part of the change, not as tidying.
A latent-vs-live misreport in either direction -- guarded by the vacuity guard AC2 and by transcribing rather than importing the comparison columns.
required_evaluation_level_reason: Public catalogue coverage badge / user-facing state. derived_state is rendered to the public page by apps/web/src/catalogue/CategoryMatrix.tsx (lines 174 and 185), and it gates the verified_free badge, which is the product's headline claim. Mandatory Level-2 category per docs/AGENT_HARNESS.md.
